question: In 1955, which synthetic element is provisionally named Mendelevium in honour of Dmitri Mendeleev, who created one of the first periodic tables?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Element 101**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dmitri Ivanovich Mendeleev was a Russian chemist and inventor.
 
• He is best remembered for formulating the Periodic Law and creating a farsighted version of the periodic table of elements.
 
• He wrote the famous book "The Principles of Chemistry".
